# Staged rollout

## Play Console

A staged rollout releases a version to a percentage of users, starting at 1% and raising it to 5%, 20% and 100%. The rollout can be halted at any percentage.

## App Store

Phased release on the App Store spreads an update over seven days and can be paused for up to thirty days.
